issue.title: Resolve the dormant Rust bead-show renderer divergence
issue.description: Deferred by epic bead sase-en in plans:202608/bead_show_speed.md; not caused by that epic. crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs::handle_show remains a dormant parity renderer that performs its own multi-issue read and lacks the live Python renderer's prose wrapping, style palette, refs, creator/page URLs, plan links, and the new single-pass detail snapshot. The host deliberately defers show away from this Rust path. Scope: decide and document whether to bring the Rust renderer to tested byte parity and activate it or delete the misleading deferred path; avoid maintaining a third output contract, and cover the chosen boundary end to end.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05 at master 0e40decdc. Each of these was re-verified as STILL REPRODUCING and is being closed as a deliberate deprioritization, not as fixed: sase-ed ('sase doctor -C project.bead_pages' still reports the same 5 misattributed commit links across sase-b5 and sase-b7 pages); sase-er (src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py:9 still imports close_mutation_commit_message and mutation_commit_message at module scope); sase-es (src/sase/main/parser.py:461 still pulls COMMAND_REGISTRARS_BY_NAME from parser_full_registrars); sase-ev (crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs:172 handle_show is still the dormant parity renderer); sase-ey (src/sase/bead/cli_detail.py still prints raw closed_at and src/sase/agents/cli_sync.py:152 still hardcodes a UTC strftime label); sase-f7 ('sase agent index verify -j' still ok=false with corrupt_rows=4, and missing_rows has grown from 2 to 77); sase-f9 ('sase bead doctor' still reports the same 14 malformed design refs, 14 sase-5l.* owner mismatches, 1 unresolvable artifact ref, and now 453 redundant close events). The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five and these did not make the cut. All scope and evidence stays readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.
